exercises.instructions: Combine the following sentences using 'not only … but also'.

questions.question: There are problems with the children. There are problems with their parents. Combine using 'not only … but also'.
options: There are problems not only with the children but also with their parents
There are problems not only with the children or also with their parents
There not only are problems with the children but also with their parents
questions.answer: There are problems not only with the children but also with their parents
questions.explanation: Place 'not only' before the first prepositional phrase and 'but also' before the second. Keep the subject and verb at the beginning. 'Not only … but also' ကို phrase နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: I sent him many letters. I tried to telephone him. Combine using 'not only … but also'.
options: I not only sent him many letters but also tried to telephone him
I not only sent him many letters or also tried to telephone him
I sent not only him many letters but also tried to telephone him
questions.answer: I not only sent him many letters but also tried to telephone him
questions.explanation: Place 'not only' before the first verb phrase and 'but also' before the second verb phrase. 'Not only … but also' ကို verb phrase နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: We visit our grandfather's house in summer. We visit our grandfather's house in winter. Combine using 'not only … but also'.
options: We visit our grandfather's house not only in summer but also in winter
We visit our grandfather's house not only in summer or also in winter
We not only visit our grandfather's house in summer but also in winter
questions.answer: We visit our grandfather's house not only in summer but also in winter
questions.explanation: Place 'not only' before the first time phrase and 'but also' before the second. 'Not only … but also' ကို time phrase နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: She can dance. She can sing. Combine using 'not only … but also'.
options: She can not only dance but also sing
She can not only dance or also sing
She not only can dance but also to sing
questions.answer: She can not only dance but also sing
questions.explanation: Place 'not only' after the modal verb and before the first verb, with 'but also' before the second verb. 'Not only … but also' ကို verb နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: They need food. They need medicine. Combine using 'not only … but also'.
options: They need not only food but also medicine
They need not only food or also medicine
They not need only food but also medicine
questions.answer: They need not only food but also medicine
questions.explanation: Place 'not only' before the first noun and 'but also' before the second noun. 'Not only … but also' ကို noun နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: She was upset. She was angry. Combine using 'not only … but also'.
options: She was not only upset but also angry
She was not only upset or also angry
She not only was upset but also angry
questions.answer: She was not only upset but also angry
questions.explanation: Place 'not only' after the verb 'was' and before the first adjective, with 'but also' before the second adjective. 'Not only … but also' ကို adjective နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: John smokes. He drinks. Combine using 'not only … but also'.
options: John not only smokes but also drinks
John not only smokes or also drinks
John smokes not only but also drinks
questions.answer: John not only smokes but also drinks
questions.explanation: Place 'not only' before the first verb and 'but also' before the second verb. 'Not only … but also' ကို verb နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: Ann has been invited to the party. Mary has been invited to the party. Combine using 'not only … but also'.
options: Not only Ann but also Mary has been invited to the party
Not only Ann but also Mary have been invited to the party
Ann not only has been invited but also Mary to the party
questions.answer: Not only Ann but also Mary has been invited to the party
questions.explanation: When the nearest subject is singular ('Mary'), the verb takes the singular form 'has'. 'Not only … but also' ကို subject နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: Maria is clever. She is beautiful. Combine using 'not only … but also'.
options: Maria is not only clever but also beautiful
Maria is not only clever or also beautiful
Maria not only is clever but also beautiful
questions.answer: Maria is not only clever but also beautiful

questions.question: The cow gives us milk. The goat gives us milk. Combine using 'not only … but also'.
options: Not only the cow but also the goat gives us milk
Not only the cow but also the goat give us milk
The cow not only gives us milk but also the goat
questions.answer: Not only the cow but also the goat gives us milk
